reported_pattern: SELECT CAST(1985 AS YEAR) succeeds with 1985, then CREATE TABLE generated YEAR expression fails with 1305 function cast_as_year missing; expected successful DDL. No generic SQL error qualifies.
normal: Both computations agree, or documented valid DDL/view works with required controls.
classification_rule: reproduced only when exact report pattern and controls hold; otherwise not_reproduced only after all required statements complete, unexpected error -> execution_failed, different anomaly -> other_anomaly.
